text:
maya (Marketing): Quick draft: Launch Blueprint — compact brief for secure enterprise deploys (SLA + deployment modes + benchmark narrative + webinar hooks). Sharing for quick pass. TL;DR: 1-page executive summary + 2-slide benchmark + 30m webinar + inbound routing checklist. Comments?

trent (Product): Wording looks sharp. Can we call out fallback routing and cost SLOs in the bullets? Also flag model variants for graceful degradation.

sam (Field): Love the webinar hooks — add a customer POV slide. Recommend customer-facing benchmark numbers: p99 latency, cost per 1k tokens, throughput. Short bullets work best.

anya (Sales): For inbound routing: suggest lead tags = { 'tier': 'enterprise', 'interest': 'private-deploy' } then route to AE queue 'Enterprise-Private'. Also add urgency tag if they request on-prem or SLA.

sam (Field): Example routing rule snippet for ops/eng to implement:
```yaml
routing: 
  - match: tags.tier == 'enterprise' && tags.interest == 'private-deploy'
    route_to: queue.enterprise-private
    priority: 90
  - match: tags.urgency == 'high'
    route_to: queue.sales-ops
    priority: 100
  - fallback: queue.general-inbound
```

trent (Product): Also need a short "what we promise" SLA blurb. Proposal: SLA = 99.95% uptime; latency SLOs by plan. @maya is that OK?

maya (Marketing): Draft SLA blurb for the brief: "SLA: 99.95% uptime. Latency targets vary by deployment: Hosted — p50 <150ms; Dedicated — p50 <50ms for typical 1k-token inference. We provide automatic fallback to compatible model variants when capacity is constrained." Thoughts? :thumbsup:

devex-bot: Heads-up — docs reference updated: https://playbook.internal/secure-deploys. Draft assets uploaded to /assets/launch-blueprint-v1.pdf

sam (Field): Benchmark narrative to include (short): test harness = 100 concurrent clients, seq len 512, model=XYZ-quant. Key numbers: hosted p99 = 420ms, dedicated p99 = 90ms, throughput = 120 req/s per GPU. Call out measurement method and caveat about quantization tradeoffs.

anya (Sales): Webinar script sketch: 5m intro (market problem + Redwood thesis), 10m demo (deploy modes + console walkthrough), 10m benchmark deep-dive (method + numbers), 5m customer Q&A. I'll own Q&A. Need registration landing copy + field-facing FAQ.

maya (Marketing): Great. Two asks before I finalize v1: (1) @sam — can you add a 2-sentence customer case study blurb we can use on slide 1? (2) @trent / ops — can you confirm Dedicated latency SLOs (numbers above) so we can publish? I'll iterate the copy and push a publish-ready launch post + webinar invite by EOD. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
